title: Apple and Cheddar rösti with fried eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, apples, eggs, cornflour, Cheddar, oil and thyme are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a tea towel, a bowl and a frying pan, and grating, squeezing and frying are within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: Six hundred grams of squeezed potato with two apples, bound with an egg and cornflour, makes enough flat cakes for four, and frying each side for 4 to 5 minutes over a medium heat will cook them through, with one fried egg each.

honest_times.reason: Grating, squeezing and frying in batches fits believably within the printed 40 minutes in total.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, every listed item, including the thyme and oil, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored apples grated through a hot potato rösti suit a February morning, and the apple is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potato, apple, cheese and eggs make a filling, proper breakfast that a family would want again.
